## DSers MCP connection check

1. Install n8n-nodes-dsers in a supported self-hosted instance, or use the local development preview.
2. Create a DSers OAuth2 API credential and complete DSers consent.
3. Assign the credential to Read DSers Account.
4. Execute this workflow manually.

This example only calls get_account_profile with empty arguments. A DSers account, required read scopes (including plan:read), and eligible plan are required.

This package is not yet verified or published. It cannot yet be installed as a verified node on n8n Cloud.

DSers: https://www.dsers.com/
